title: QuantumCrate
description: A Minecraft crate plugin for Paper 1.21 built around a web-first management philosophy — configure everything from a browser dashboard without touching a single config file or restarting the server.
body:
Click here to view the text-based description (Accessibility Alternative) # Quantum Crates **Web Based Crates Plugin** A Minecraft crate plugin built around a web-first management philosophy — configure everything from a browser dashboard without touching a single config file or restarting the server. ## Key Features *More details available on our [Wiki](https://www.bintanq.my.id/docs/quantumcrates/introduction).* * **Website Dashboard:** Manage everything from your browser. No need to configure YAML or anything. * **GUI Animation:** A cool GUI animation you can configure on the web dashboard. * **Pity System:** First Soft & Hard pity system. Just like other RPG games' pity systems. * **Particle Animation:** Cool idle & open animation types to make your crates more eye-catchy. * **Live Analytics:** Real-time opening feed via Web Dashboard. Maintain player logs. * **Crates Schedule:** Configure your crates to be opened on specific time, day or limited events. ## Preview Dashboard Try it by yourself! The web dashboard includes intuitive menus for: * **Main:** Crate Architect, Analytics & Logs (Live). * **Config:** Key Settings, Messages, Players, and Settings. * **Crate Management:** Easily adjust Reward Chances/Weights, Pity Systems, Schedules, Key Requirements, Holograms, Idle & Open Particles, and GUI Animation styles directly from the browser. ## Help / Support / Suggestion? Join our *[Discord](https://discord.com/invite/DfZ8mHneAV)*
![QuantumCrates Header Banner](https://i.imgur.com/kfhA9ox.png)[![QuantumCrates Documentation Link](https://i.imgur.com/Sz8r5ZH.png)](https://www.bintanq.my.id/docs/quantumcrates/introduction)![QuantumCrates Web Dashboard Preview](https://i.ibb.co.com/KzyStmds/Dashboard-Preview.png)[![Join QuantumCrates Discord Support](https://i.imgur.com/KqE7Iq4.png)](https://discord.com/invite/DfZ8mHneAV) ![bStats](https://bstats.org/signatures/bukkit/QuantumCrate.svg) --- ### **Experience the Future of Crate Management** QuantumCrates is a revolutionary Minecraft plugin designed with a **Web-First philosophy**. Manage your crates, rewards, and real-time statistics through a powerful, built-in web dashboard.
